messages:
maya: Dropping a compact prototype for the API Key manager UI. Looking for focused microcopy suggestions, keyboard shortcut ideas, and a11y/privacy notes. figma: https://figma.com/proto/unique (placeholder)
eli: Microcopy first: empty state should be task-oriented, e.g. \"No API keys yet — create a key to start making requests\". Offer a tiny SDK example (Python) instead of only curl.
sam: Keyboard/flow: modal should trap focus. Suggest a keyboard shortcut to open Create modal: Ctrl+Alt+K (opt-in, shown in a tooltip). After rotation focus the success panel Copy button, not the raw value.
nora: Accessibility: when showing the one-time key, do NOT put the secret into the accessibility tree. Use aria-hidden on the raw element and announce via aria-live: \"A new API key was created and is temporarily available. Use the reveal button to view it for 10 seconds.\"
jordan: Privacy nudge: add a faint diagonal watermark over the revealed key area with \"Sensitive\" and an optional ephemeral overlay that hints \"Avoid screenshots in public places\". Not foolproof, but reduces accidental exposure.
eli: SDK sample suggestion for the empty state (one-liner):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="<KEY>")
print(client.health())
```
shows a clear next step for devs.
sam: Implementation sketch for one-time reveal:
```js
if (resp.one_time_key) {
  showKeyPlaceholder();
  focus(copyBtn);
  announceLive('New API key created. Reveal to view.');
  setTimeout(() => { hideKey(); }, 10000);
}
```
Use 10s default and allow a per-user preference to extend to 30s.
nora: Revoke safety: require typed confirmation when key.affects_org || usageCount > 1. For single-use keys a quick confirm + undo snackbar (25s) is fine. Add explicit aria-labels to the danger control: \"Confirm revoke API key (danger)\".
jordan: UI idea: show an inline \"impact preview\" before destructive actions: first 3 affected services + \"and N more\". Make this collapsible so we don't overwhelm rows.
eli: Copy UX: add an optional keyboard shortcut to copy when the reveal panel is focused: Ctrl+Shift+C. Telemetry: track keys.copy_shortcut_used as well as copy button clicks. Use full-sentence toast: \"API key copied to clipboard. Update any integrations that used the old key.\"
sam: On the front-end avoid leaving the secret string in the DOM unprotected. Render into an ephemeral shadow node and remove it when hidden. Consider a QR export flow for phone-to-phone transfer (opt-in).
nora: Voiceover nuance: don't read the key itself; instead announce \"New API key created. Reveal control is available.\" Provide helper text: \"This is the only time the full key is shown. Save it now.\" with aria-describedby.
maya: Nice. I'll update the prototype with: 1) empty-state Python example and CTA text, 2) keyboard shortcut hint for modal (optional), 3) reveal timer 10s default plus per-user extension toggle, 4) sensitive watermark, 5) typed-confirm rules for revoke, and 6) ARIA notes including aria-hidden for raw key. Filing KEYUX-2026 and assigning to @sam. ETA: next sprint.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 18:45 UTC (automated:deploy)
maya: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" I'll post updated screenshots once the mock is pushed.
